name: rule5_sweep2
instructions: Rule-5 sweep, behaviour identical. Find the absolute pixel / size / offset / timing / ratio literals used inside function bodies (not already in a const line, not 0, 1, -1, 2 in arithmetic, not indices, not Color channels, not font sizes, not values already passed through UiTheme or Palette). Name each one as a typed `const` near the top of the file (SCREAMING_SNAKE, e.g. `const PAD_PX: float = 6.0`, with a `##` one-line comment) and use the const at the use site. Reuse an existing const in the file when it holds the same number with the same meaning; if the same number appears in several places with the same meaning, one const. Keep int vs float exactly as written (a literal 4 stays an int const, 4.0 a float const; do not change the expression's type or value). Do NOT change any value, any logic, any signature, any existing const name, or any string. Do not touch draw_string size arguments or font sizes (a separate lint covers them). Put the new consts together after the existing const block. If the file has nothing to name, status: skip.
